correctness.rationale: Legendre identity gives v_q binom(qn,n)=s_q((q-1)2^e)/(q-1) exactly. Lucas/Kummer parity gives binom(q^2,q) even for every odd prime q, excluding t=1. When q>2^e, the base-q digits of (q-1)2^e sum to q-1, excluding t>=2; equality q=2^e cannot occur for odd q. CRT reduces remaining finite checks to binomial mod 2^e. Recomputed every possible (q,t) candidate for e<=4 with exact integers and full-modulus checks: 36 and 400 alone survive. The unrestricted finiteness rests on the digit-and-carry argument.
